description: I'm an IoT Quality Engineer Intern at Haier Europe, working on the company's IoT systems with a focus on the hOn app. I run functional testing on a large-scale ecosystem of connected devices, validating features against Product Owner specifications and acceptance criteria through end-to-end scenarios. I write test cases and report bugs in Jira with reproducible reports, and collaborate with developers and Product Owners to keep spec and implementation aligned, in a daily English-based workflow.
